name: SAKURA Chat Layout & Composer Hotfix
problem_reproduced: The composer DOM contains microphone, textarea and send button, but v17.15.4 declared only two grid columns.
The textarea collapsed into a narrow vertical strip and the send button moved to a second row.
The active chat view inherited nested scrolling and the message column felt visually disconnected.
changes: Explicit placement for microphone, textarea and send button.
One vertical scrollbar owned by the active view.
Messages aligned as a conversation column close to the composer.
Feedback and message actions wrap without clipping.
Responsive compact and mobile composer remains one horizontal row.
